researched_writeups.title: PDD Holdings (ticker: PDD)
researched_writeups.summary: PDD's C2M (Consumer-to-Manufacturer) model and asset-light social commerce aggregate price-sensitive demand while generating high-margin transaction and online marketing revenues. Trading at an ex-cash P/E of ~5.0x with roughly $60 billion in cash and short-term investments, the market prices PDD as an ex-growth utility despite rapid international scaling via Temu. Key catalysts include Temu proving unit-economic profitability through its semi-managed model pivot and potential future capital returns to shareholders.

researched_writeups.title: Deep Dive: PDD Holdings ($PDD)
researched_writeups.summary: Driven by Himalaya Capital's ~20% portfolio allocation into PDD, this deep dive highlights PDD's zero-inventory supply chain, disintermediated factory-direct sourcing, and $59.5B net cash position representing over 35% of its market cap. Discounted cash flow analysis yields an intrinsic value of $166–$189 per share (50%+ upside) under conservative assumptions of 5% post-2027 international growth to account for de minimis tariff friction. Operational catalysts rely on Temu navigating Western trade barriers and management adopting shareholder-friendly buybacks or dividends.

researched_writeups.title: PDD still looks cheap, even after the Temu boom
researched_writeups.summary: The analysis demonstrates that PDD's market price implicitly models an overly pessimistic scenario: long-term net margins compressing to 9.2% and top-line growth falling rapidly to 7.5%. By modeling domestic Pinduoduo's resilient high-margin ad take-rates and Temu's transition toward semi-managed logistics, the post estimates intrinsic value at RMB 2,230 per share (~212% upside, 25.2% IRR). Operational catalysts center on market recognition of normalized 20%+ EBIT platform margins despite temporary geopolitical and tariff noise.

researched_writeups.title: PDD Holdings Inc (PDD) Stock Analysis, Valuation, Scorecard
researched_writeups.summary: The pitch analyzes PDD as a low-inventory, capital-light demand engine that monetizes merchant advertising and order fulfillment services at expanding margins relative to top-line growth. Leveraging C2M supply chain advantages across domestic China and global markets, the business benefits from a ~$75 billion cash and short-term investment balance sheet. Key catalysts focus on continued take-rate expansion in high-margin advertising services and the operational leverage inherent in matching fragmented consumer demand with direct manufacturers.
